get.summary:
Lists Actions by Project Code, then Reference. Only open Actions are
listed unless `state` says otherwise.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this Project's Actions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–1000.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Open (the default), closed or all Actions.

schema.description: Which Actions or Risks to list by state.

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Only Actions assigned to this Person ID, or `unassigned`.

parameters.name: due_by
parameters.description: Only Actions due on or before this date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

post.summary: Creates an open Action with the next Reference in its Project.

get.summary: Fetches an Action, open or closed.

put.summary:
Replaces an Action's description, assignee and due date. Needs a session
and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

patch.summary:
Closes or reopens an Action, with `{"closed": …}` as
`application/merge-patch+json`. Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

get.summary:
Lists Blockers by Project Code, then Reference. Only open Blockers are
listed unless `state` says otherwise.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this Project's Blockers.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–1000.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Open (the default), cleared or all Blockers.

schema.description: Which Blockers to list by state.

parameters.name: accountable
parameters.description: Only Blockers this Person ID is accountable for, or `unassigned`.

post.summary: Creates an open Blocker with the next Reference in its Project.

get.summary: Fetches a Blocker, open or cleared.

put.summary:
Replaces a Blocker's description and accountable Member. Needs a session
and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

patch.summary:
Clears or reopens a Blocker, with `{"cleared": …}` as
`application/merge-patch+json`. Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

post.summary:
Links the Blocker to an Action in the same Project that it blocks, in
any state. Linking an already linked Action changes nothing. Needs a
session and the Blocker's `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the Blocker version being changed

422.description: No such Action, or in another Project

delete.summary:
Removes the Blocker's link to an Action, in any state. Unlinking an
Action that is not linked changes nothing. Needs a session and the
Blocker's `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the Blocker version being changed

get.summary: Lists People, ordered by ID unless `sort` is given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–1000.

post.summary:
Creates a Person. Allowed without a session, so the first Person can be
created; they then become their own Acting Person.

set-cookie.description: Set when there was no session

put.summary: Replaces a Person. Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

get.summary:
Lists Projects, ordered by ID unless `sort` is given. Archived Projects
are left out unless `include_archived=true`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–1000.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived Projects.

post.summary: Creates a Project. The Acting Person becomes a Member and its Project Leader.

get.summary: Suggests an unused Project Code for a name (FR-16).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Project name to suggest a code for.

get.summary: Fetches a Project, archived or not.

put.summary:
Replaces a Project's name, description, Health Rating and Project Leader.
Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

patch.summary:
Archives or unarchives a Project, with `{"archived": …}` as
`application/merge-patch+json`. Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

get.summary:
Downloads a Project, archived or not, with all its Members, Actions, Risks
and Blockers as an attachment named `<project-code>-<date>.json`. Needs a
session.

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.description: Include the Change History.

get.summary: Lists a Project's Members, archived Project or not.

post.summary:
Adds a Person as a Member. Adding an existing Member changes nothing; a
Person added back is not reassigned their old items. Needs a session and
the Project's `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the Project version being changed

delete.summary:
Removes a Member. Their open Actions and Blockers become unassigned, and
removing the Project Leader leaves no Project Leader. Needs a session and
the Project's `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the Project version being changed

404.description: No such Project, or not a Member

get.summary:
Lists Risks, ordered by ID unless `sort` is given. Only open Risks are
listed unless `state` says otherwise.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this Project's Risks.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–1000.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Open (the default), closed or all Risks.

schema.description: Which Actions or Risks to list by state.

post.summary: Creates an open Risk with the next Reference in its Project.

get.summary: Fetches a Risk, open or closed.

put.summary:
Replaces a Risk's description, likelihood and impact. Needs a session and
`If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

patch.summary:
Closes or reopens a Risk, with `{"closed": …}` as
`application/merge-patch+json`. Needs a session and `If-Match`.

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed

post.summary: Sets the Acting Person, in a signed session cookie. Needs no session.

Action.description:
An Action. Also the request body for `POST` and `PUT`: read-only fields
may be sent to `PUT` only if they match what is stored.

oneOf.description: A Member, or `null` when unassigned. Only `id` is read. Required on `PUT`.

blocked_by.description: The open Blockers blocking this Action, ordered by Reference.

description.description: 1–4000 characters once trimmed; may span lines.

due_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; past dates are allowed. Required on `PUT`.

reference.description: `A-001`, … numbered within the Project. A label, not an identifier.

Blocker.description:
A Blocker. Also the request body for `POST` and `PUT`: read-only fields
may be sent to `PUT` only if they match what is stored.

oneOf.description: The accountable Member, or `null`. Only `id` is read. Required on `PUT`.

blocked_actions.description:
The Actions this Blocker blocks, ordered by Reference. Changed only
through `/blockers/{id}/blocked_actions`.

description.description: 1–4000 characters once trimmed; may span lines.

reference.description: `B-001`, … numbered within the Project. A label, not an identifier.

ChangeHistoryEntry.description:
One Change History entry, with its snapshots exactly as stored. Snapshots
follow the domain shape when the entry was written, not `format_version`.

caused_by.description: The entry that triggered this one, if any.

version.description: The entity version this change produced.

project_code.description: `null` when the name has too few letters to suggest one.

HealthRating.description: A Project's Health Rating, set by hand (FR-70).

ItemRef.description: Another item, by ID and Reference.

MemberList.description: A Project's Members, ordered by display name.

NewMember.description: The Person to add as a Member.

Person.description:
A Person. Also the request body for `POST` and `PUT`: read-only fields may
be sent only if they match what is stored.

display_name.description: Required, 1–100 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

PersonRef.description: A Person as shown on something that refers to them.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details object, served as `application/problem+json`.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status code says what went wrong.

Project.description:
A Project. Also the request body for `POST` and `PUT`: read-only fields may
be sent to `PUT` only if they match what is stored.

description.description: 1–4000 characters once trimmed, or `null`. Required on `PUT`.

oneOf.description: `null` when the Project is not rated. Required on `PUT`.

name.description: Required, 1–100 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

project_code.description:
Set on creation and never changed: an uppercase letter followed by
1–9 uppercase letters or digits, unique across Projects.

oneOf.description:
The creator, to begin with. Must be a Member; `null` means no
Project Leader. Required on `PUT`, where only `id` is read.

ProjectExport.description: A whole Project as one JSON document (FR-110).

actions.description: Every Action, closed ones included, ordered by Reference.

blockers.description: Every Blocker, cleared ones included, ordered by Reference.

change_history.description:
Present only with `include_history=true`: every entry for the
Project and its items, in the order recorded.

people.description: Every Person the document mentions, ordered by display name.

risks.description: Every Risk, closed ones included, ordered by Reference.

Risk.description:
A Risk. Also the request body for `POST` and `PUT`: read-only fields may
be sent to `PUT` only if they match what is stored.

description.description: 1–4000 characters once trimmed; may span lines.

reference.description: `R-001`, … numbered within the Project. A label, not an identifier.
